episode.title: 洪太尉误走妖魔

shots.action: 瘟疫笼罩的东京城，宫墙寂静
shots.image_prompt: vast capital city palace under plague, gloomy fog, empty courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 那一年春天，东京城闹起了瘟疫，家家闭户，满城愁云。

shots.action: 仁宗端坐金殿，洪太尉跪接诏书，百官伏地
shots.image_prompt: emperor on the golden throne, goose kneeling before the steps, courtiers kneeling in rows

dialogue.speaker: song_renzong
dialogue.text: 洪太尉，你持朕的丹诏，去龙虎山请天师进京，禳除瘟疫。

dialogue.speaker: hong_xin
dialogue.text: 臣领旨！这点小事，包在臣身上。

shots.action: 太尉的队伍沿江边官道南下，远处群山
shots.image_prompt: a tiny procession with followers on the long road beside the river, distant blue mountains, dusk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 洪太尉带着随从，背着丹诏，一路向南，直奔江西龙虎山。

shots.action: 龙虎山云海，上清宫隐现半山
shots.image_prompt: majestic mountains rising from mist, temple halls, bell tower, morning

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 龙虎山上，云雾千重，上清宫钟鼓齐鸣。

shots.action: 真人率道众在宫前迎接太尉
shots.image_prompt: temple courtyard, the tortoise abbot and priests greet the goose official in front of the hall

dialogue.speaker: zhenren
dialogue.text: 天师住在山顶草庵。太尉须斋戒沐浴，独自步行上山，方显诚心。

dialogue.speaker: hong_xin
dialogue.text: 什么？要本官自己爬上去？

shots.action: 太尉独自在蜿蜒石阶上爬山，身影极小
shots.image_prompt: a tiny goose climbing the winding mountain path alone, pine trees, clouds below

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 山路又陡又长，太尉爬得腿软气喘。

dialogue.speaker: hong_xin
dialogue.text: 我在京城锦衣玉食，何曾吃过这种苦！

shots.action: 狂风骤起，猛虎跃出松林，太尉仰面跌倒
shots.image_prompt: strong wind, the goose falls backwards on the steps as a huge tiger leaps out of the pine forest

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 忽然狂风大作，松林里跳出一只吊睛白额的大虫！

shots.action: 雪白大蛇横在路中，太尉抱头大喊
shots.image_prompt: a giant white serpent coils across the mountain path, the goose trembles, mist

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 刚爬起来，又一条雪白大蛇横在路上。

dialogue.speaker: hong_xin
dialogue.text: 救命啊——

shots.action: 山坡上道童倒骑黄牛吹笛而来，太尉在远处呆望
shots.image_prompt: on a distant grassy ridge a little crane boy riding a yellow ox plays a flute, the goose watches, golden afternoon

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 远处传来一阵笛声，一个小道童倒骑黄牛，转过山坡。

dialogue.speaker: zhang_tianshi
dialogue.text: 你是来请天师的吧？天师早上已经驾鹤进京啦！

shots.action: 真人跌足叹气，太尉愣在原地
shots.image_prompt: temple courtyard at dusk, the tortoise abbot sighs, the goose stands stunned

dialogue.speaker: zhenren
dialogue.text: 太尉啊，那骑牛的道童，正是天师本人！

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 太尉当面错过了真人。

shots.action: 右廊尽头，朱门紧锁、封条交叉的伏魔之殿
shots.image_prompt: the goose and the tortoise abbot stand before the sealed hall, red doors with crossed paper seals

dialogue.speaker: hong_xin
dialogue.text: 这殿为何贴满封条？

dialogue.speaker: zhenren
dialogue.text: 这是老祖天师镇锁魔王之处，万万开不得！

shots.action: 太尉摆出官威，道众战战兢兢撕下封条
shots.image_prompt: priests tear off the paper seals of the sealed hall while the goose official points, the abbot bows

dialogue.speaker: hong_xin
dialogue.text: 本官偏要看看魔王长什么样！给我打开！

shots.action: 漆黑殿内，火把映出龟趺石碑，碑上“遇洪而开”
shots.image_prompt: inside the dark hall, torches, a stone tablet on a tortoise base carved with 「遇洪而开」

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 殿中立着一块石碑，背面凿着四个大字——遇洪而开。

dialogue.speaker: hong_xin
dialogue.text: 哈哈！这碑等的正是我洪某人！

shots.action: 众人掘倒石碑，掀开青石板，露出深不见底的地穴
shots.image_prompt: workers dug up the tablet, it lies tilted beside a bottomless pit , torches

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 众人掘倒石碑，掀开石板，下面是一个深不见底的地穴。

shots.action: 黑气从地穴冲天而起，众人东倒西歪
shots.image_prompt: black smoke bursts out of the pit , the goose falls, the tortoise kneels

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 一声巨响，一道黑气从地穴里冲天而起！

shots.action: 黑气掀开殿顶，化作百十道金光四散
shots.image_prompt: black smoke erupts through the roof of the sealed hall into the sky and splits into golden light streaks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 黑气掀开殿顶，在半空中化作百十道金光，四散飞去。

shots.action: 夜空中一百零八颗魔星划向四方
shots.image_prompt: night sky full of shooting stars streaking to every direction over the ridges

dialogue.speaker: zhenren
dialogue.text: 太尉，你闯下大祸了！三十六天罡、七十二地煞，全被放出去了！

shots.action: 夜色中太尉一行仓皇下山回京，天边残留流星
shots.image_prompt: night, a tiny procession with followers hurries along the long road beside the river, stars fading in the sky

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: 太尉连夜逃回京城，对此事绝口不提。可那一百零八颗魔星，已经散落人间。

episode.cliffhanger: 一百零八颗魔星散落人间，第一颗，会落在谁的身上？
